remarks: Welcome to Candlelight Terrace-this beautifully updated one-bedroom, one-bath corner residence offers bright interiors, modern finishes, and peaceful river views in one of Stamford's most desirable communities. Enjoy an updated kitchen, refreshed bath, new flooring, and abundant natural light throughout. Step out onto your private terrace overlooking the river-an ideal place to enjoy morning coffee, unwind at the end of the day, or simply relax and take in the tranquil setting. Candlelight Terrace offers beautifully maintained grounds, a sparkling pool, and communal grilling areas for outdoor enjoyment. Conveniently located in central Stamford with easy access to shopping, dining, parks, and transportation. Heat and hot water are included.
